the use of intragastric infusion of milk powder and carbohydrate to maintain metabolic balance in patients with severe acute pancreatitis is associated with a reduction in protein catabolic rate.
the diet of intravenous glucose, amino acids and electrolytes is a useful method of maintaining the metabolic balance of severely ill patients.
the intragastric infusion of a liquid diet in patients with severe acute pancreatitis is associated with a decrease in protein and energy catabolism and a reduction in the incidence of complications.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the intragastric administration of milk powder and dextrose is a satisfactory method of maintaining metabolic balance.
the intravenous diet was not a satisfactory diet for the patient with acute pancreatitis.
